question: Mr. U starts from Point F and drives 2 km towards the west. He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 10 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 4 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point O. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point F again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Mr. U starts from Point F and drives 2 km towards the west.

He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 10 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 4 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/035bf2a85178ccf048811f16a7cd0ef96f44a14a57f3c7d9b430e47c971b5774.png] 

Thus, Mr. U has to drive 6 km north to reach point F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
